'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**[[Iran]]ian security forces open fire on anti-[[Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran|government]] protesters in [[Divandarreh]], [[Kurdistan province]], killing three people. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/19/iran-security-forces-shoot-dead-at-least-three-civilians (''The Guardian'')]
**The [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian military]] deploys [[armoured personnel carrier]]s in [[Mahabad]], [[West Azerbaijan province]], amid fears of a [[massacre]] in the restive city. The [[Iran Human Rights]] group reports heavy gunfire. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-activists-fear-deadly-crackdown-in-kurdish-populated-mahabad/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least nine people, including four children, are killed and an unknown number of others are missing after a [[gas explosion]] occurs at a five-story [[residential building]] in [[Tymovskoye]], [[Sakhalin]], [[Russia]], causing a section of the building to collapse. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/explosion-kills-at-lt-9-on-russias-island-of-sakhalin/2022/11/19/6601a692-67e5-11ed-b08c-3ce222607059_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
* Four people are killed over [[Snohomish County]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]],  as a [[Cessna 208B]] disintegrates in mid-air. [https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/4-fatalities-now-confirmed-in-snohomish-county-plane-crash/ (The Seattle Times)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 United Nations Climate Change Conference]]
**A representative from the [[European Union]] reports that [[List of parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change|the parties]] to the [[United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change]] have agreed to establish a [[Loss and damage (climate change)|loss and damage]] fund for countries [[Climate change vulnerability|vulnerable to the effects of climate change]] on the final day of the conference. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/deal-reached-on-loss-and-damage-fund-at-un-climate-talks-report-3535821 (AFP via NDTV)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Malaysian general election]]
**[[Malaysians]] head to the [[Polling place|polls]] to elect members of the [[Dewan Rakyat]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/18/asia/malaysia-15th-general-election-explainer-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Asteroid impact prediction]], {{mpl|2022 WJ|1}}
**A {{convert|1|m|ft|adj=on|abbr=off}} near-Earth [[asteroid]] is discovered before falling as a harmless [[bolide]] over central [[Ontario]], [[Canada]], at 08:27 UTC. It is the sixth asteroid to be discovered before impacting Earth. [https://earthsky.org/space/asteroid-hit-canada-mere-hours-after-discovery/ (CNN)] [https://earthsky.org/space/asteroid-hit-canada-mere-hours-after-discovery/ (''EarthSky'')]
*[[Social media use by Donald Trump]]
**After holding an impromptu [[Open-access poll|online poll]], [[Twitter]] owner [[Elon Musk]] restores the [[Twitter suspensions|suspended]] account of former [[First presidency of Donald Trump|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. More than 15 million people voted in the poll, although Musk acknowledged many bots may also have voted. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/nov/20/twitter-lifts-donald-trump-ban-after-elon-musks-poll (''The Guardian'')]
